headline: Operation Iron Gate 'in effect' ('nothing comes in by land')

sources: Donald Trump, remarks to reporters in West Palm Beach, Florida, Nov 8, 2026; White House schedule (Qatar PM meeting); White House X post (Iron Gate 'fully operational')
fault_line: Real three-way deal -- or a photo-op before the next strike? Social chatter is heavy on the Xi-Putin handshake imagery (RusEmbassy post 5.7K likes/500 comments Nov 3) and three-way speculation, thin on Iron Gate specific

sections.what_happened: [VERIFIED FACT -- the quotes] Trump said he thinks he will meet Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin at the APEC summit in Shenzhen, Nov 18-19: 'One of the meetings, I think, will be with President Putin and President Xi. And that'll be interesting. We'll talk a lot of things, including denuclearisation... We're trying to end the war in Iran, and we're doing well because, you know, all we have to do, we're choking it off.' He said Operation Iron Gate 'is now in effect': 'That means nothing comes in by land. And as you know, the naval blockade, nothing comes in by water.' A White House X post states the task force is 'in full force and effect'. [VERIFIED FACT] Trump meets Qatar PM Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani at the White House today, Monday Nov 9, closed-door, ~12:00 ET (20:00 ); VP JD Vance meets him separately first. Qatar is the mediator conveying proposals between Washington and Tehran; Axios (via Mezha) says the Qatari PM wants Trump to give diplomacy more time. [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM] The three-way APEC meeting itself is Trump's expectation only ('I think') -- China's Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning did NOT confirm an agreement for a three-way meeting.
sections.what_verified: 5 distinct publisher families with declared tiers: Reuters T1, Al Jazeera T2 (STATE QA), Nikkei Asia T2, Gulf News T3, Jerusalem Post T3 (Qatar meeting). Attribution-only (NOT counted, no declared tier): EconoTimes, AsiaOne, Dawn (Reuters carry -- counts as Reuters family), Moneycontrol, Times Now, KuCoin, Mezha (Axios carry -- Axios is T2 but the carry here is via Mezha, counted conservatively as attribution-only).
sections.what_disputed: China has not confirmed the three-way meeting (Mao Ning: China 'communicating with relevant parties', no agreement confirmed). The WSJ reported Putin pitched the trilateral to discuss ending the Ukraine war, not Iran -- agendas diverge. Rubio the same day: 'no progress' on Iran talks, demands 'unacceptable'/'outrageous'. The IRGC dismissed Iron Gate as 'just a play on words' (spokesperson Hossein Mohebi, via AJ). CENTCOM's Nov 7 Iron Gate announcement (recorded totw-20261107) already covered the task force's creation; this item is Trump's 'in effect' declaration + the APEC/Qatar news, not the creation. PortWatch: NO live Hormuz count available -- snapshot stale (latest observation Nov 1, 8-day lag); no counted transit figure is cited for Iron Gate's effect.
sections.why_matters: Trump says he's choking Iran off by land now -- and wants Xi and Putin in the same room to talk denuclearisation. But Beijing hasn't confirmed the meeting, Rubio says talks are going nowhere, and the land blockade is a 20-person unit against 5,900 km of borders. Claim-bust frame: 'in effect' vs what it can actually enforce.

totw_analysis: Our read: Trump says he's choking Iran off by land now -- and wants Xi and Putin in the same room to talk denuclearisation. But Beijing hasn't confirmed the meeting, Rubio says talks are going nowhere, and the land blockade is a 20-person unit against 5,900 km of borders. Claim-bust frame: 'in effect' vs what it can actually enforce. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Real three-way deal -- or a photo-op before the next strike? Social chatter is heavy on the Xi-Putin handshake imagery (RusEmbassy post 5.7K likes/500 comments Nov 3) and three-way speculation, thin on Iron Gate specifics.
